description: Audits a manager's workspace files (meeting notes, plans, tasks, logs) to detect orphaned files, forgotten action items, duplicates, and plan-to-reality drift. Use when you want to clean up your workspace, run a weekly hygiene check, find forgotten commitments buried in notes, or spot conflicting information across project documents. Triggers RU: «аудит воркспейса», «проверь рабочую папку», «найди забытые задачи», «почисти workspace», «что я забыл сделать». Triggers EN: workspace audit, workspace health check, find forgotten tasks, orphaned files, weekly cleanup.
